mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ssm_query_session( session_id , query_id , ds_key, server_ip, created_time, created_by, template_id, view_id, olap_api_key ) VALUES( #{sessionId}, #{queryId}, #{dsKey}, #{serverIp}, now(), #{createdBy}, #{templateId}, #{viewId}, #{olapApiKey} ) on duplicate key update query_id = #{queryId}, ds_key = #{dsKey}, server_ip = #{serverIp}, created_time = now(), created_by = #{createdBy}, template_id = #{templateId}, view_id = #{viewId}, olap_api_key = #{olapApiKey}
mapper.select: SELECT session_id as sessonId, query_id as queryId, ds_key as dsKey, server_ip as serverIp, created_time as createdTime, created_by as createdBy, template_id as templateId, view_id as viewId, DATE_FORMAT(created_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdTime, olap_api_key as olapApiKey FROM ssm_query_session t WHERE t.session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT session_id as sessionId, query_id as queryId, ds_key as dsKey, server_ip as serverIp, created_time as createdTime, created_by as createdBy, template_id as templateId, view_id as viewId, DATE_FORMAT(created_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdTime, olap_api_key as olapApiKey FROM ssm_query_session t where t.created_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 10 minute)

select t.scope, t.user_name as userName, t.template_id as templateId, t.option_code as optionCode, t.option_value as optionValue, t.option_desc as optionDesc, t.support_query_engines as supportQueryEngines from ssm_query_settings t where 1=1 and t.is_active = 1

select t1.template_id as templateId, t1.view_id as viewId , t1.max_session as maxSession, t1.start_time as startTime, t1.end_time as endTime from bi_ssm.ssm_rate_limit_template_view t1 where 1=1 and t1.is_active = 1
select t1.table_name as tableName, t1.max_partition_count as maxPartitionCount from bi_ssm.ssm_partition_limit_table t1 where t1.is_active = 1

/*ssm-system.probe*/ select coalesce(sum(t1.splits), 0) as splitCount, coalesce(count(distinct t1.query_id), 0) as queryCount from system.runtime.tasks t1 inner join system.runtime.queries t2 on t1.query_id = t2.query_id where t1.state = 'RUNNING' and t2.state = 'RUNNING' and t2.query not like '/*ssm-system.probe*/%'
